name: THE STAGE DRIVER
note: Doc 17 v2 PART TWO, verbatim. He is the exposition, not Hob -- Hob speaks forty words across two acts and that is a design invariant. Options 1, 2, 4 and 5 carry the setting, the premise, the money problem and the first objective; all four are optional and a player who skips him entirely still reaches Room 2. Option 5 pays off in twenty minutes: the undertaker does know everybody, because he buried Ezra Pike in 1852. His EXIT line departs the coach -- beat 7 is player-triggered, not a timer.

root.say: Four days from Sacramento. Four days.
